paragraphs.text: Dear Hiring Manager, I am applying for the Senior Backend Engineer position on the Platform Team because its focus on designing and operating high-throughput APIs at several million requests per day aligns with my background. As Senior Backend Engineer at Northwind Data, I worked on systems that handled 2M requests/day across 3 regions. API p95 latency improved by 40% between 2019 and 2024 during that period. I am motivated to contribute to a team that owns reliability targets and on-call for its data platform.

The job description's emphasis on production Kubernetes experience and end-to-end cluster ownership matches my background managing Kubernetes in production, including a zero-downtime migration of 40+ services. I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Toronto, meeting the required degree, and I created a PostgreSQL schema-automation tool now used by 5 teams, demonstrating hands-on work with PostgreSQL at scale.

These achievements reflect a commitment to reliable, scalable infrastructure: a zero-downtime Kubernetes migration of 40+ services, a PostgreSQL schema-automation tool now used by 5 teams, and API p95 latency improving by 40% between 2019 and 2024 at 2M requests/day across 3 regions. I would welcome the chance to discuss how this experience supports the Platform Team's goals. Thank you for your consideration.
